definitions.Inheritance: A class reuses another class's behaviour
definitions.Polymorphism: Same call, different behaviour by type
definitions.Overriding: A subclass replaces a parent method
definitions.Interface: A contract of methods to implement
definitions.Recursion: A function calling itself; not OOP-specific
definitions.Closure: A function remembering its scope; not OOP
definitions.Hoisting: JS moves declarations up; not OOP
definitions.Memory leak: Memory never freed; not an OOP concept
definitions.Factory: Creates objects without naming the class
definitions.Decorator: Wraps an object to add behaviour
definitions.Builder: Builds complex objects step by step
definitions.Facade: A simple front for a complex system
definitions.Callback: Function passed to run later; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Middleware: A request pipeline step; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Pagination: Splitting results into pages; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Debounce: Waits for calm before firing; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Throttle: Limits call rate; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Load balancer: Spreads traffic; not a GoF pattern
definitions.Sprint: A fixed short cycle of work
definitions.Backlog: Prioritised list of work to do
definitions.Retrospective: Team review of what to improve
definitions.Velocity: Work a team finishes per sprint
definitions.User story: A feature written from the user's view
definitions.Epic: A large story split into smaller ones
definitions.Burndown: Chart of work remaining over time
definitions.Hotfix: Urgent production patch; not an agile term
definitions.Rollback: Reverting a release; not an agile term
definitions.Blue-green: A release strategy; not an agile term
definitions.Code freeze: Pause on changes before release; not agile
